HowItWorks.title: From raw file to on-chain commitment
HowItWorks.subtitle: Three steps, three minutes, one hash per data period.
HowItWorks.step1Desc: Metrics are canonicalized into deterministic bytes, hashed with keccak256 into a Merkle root.
HowItWorks.step2Desc: The issuer wallet (CDP/MetaMask) signs commitData, pays its own gas, receives the receipt.
HowItWorks.step3Desc: Chainlink CRE oracle network verifies the commitment and seals the OracleVerified status on-chain.

FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.a1: Not yet. Phase 1 runs on Base Sepolia. Mainnet requires the legal readiness gate.
FAQ.q2: Do you custody funds or keys?
FAQ.a2: No. You hold your own wallet (CDP/MetaMask) and sign locally.
FAQ.a3: Off-chain, AES-GCM encrypted. On-chain holds only hash, Merkle root and metadata.
FAQ.a4: The CRE workflow calls the on-chain OracleConsumer and seals the OracleVerified status. Currently running on testnet pilot via local simulator; mainnet will use full DON consensus.
FAQ.a5: Issuer teams: upload data, sign commits, browse commitment history.
FAQ.a6: Take the raw file + run the public hashing lib — compare the root with on-chain data on Basescan.
